column10: A 3D printer is a device that can make objects in three dimensions, unlike regular printers which only print flat, two dimentional, images. They work by taking a 3D model of an object from a computer and building the object layer by layer, like a Sand Castle. There are a lot of different ways a 3D printer can do this, including some ways that use lazers. You can use your computer to draw something and then the 3D printer makes it come to life. Maybe you have a toy that you want to design that only exists in your mind. If you can draw it on a computer, maybe with the help of your mom or dad, then the 3D printer can turn it into a real object. Most 3D printers only make small objects that could fit in your hand, but some are extremely big. The University of Maine has made a 3D printer that can print objects that are 100 feet long. That's as long as a Blue Whale. The concept of 3D printing has been around since the 1940s, but the first working one was invented in Japan 1981 by Dr. Hideo Kodama.
